method: Area-weighted 8-day MOD11A2 composites grouped by start month. Accept produced pixels (mandatory QA 0 or 1) with good detailed data quality and estimated LST error ≤2 K. At least 30% of each reference area per composite and half of source composites per month. Fixed district-local urban and non-built land masks require agreement in 2003, 2013 and 2023; at least 5 km² of reference area; paired strata share composite dates. Non-built reference includes natural and agricultural land.
